title: Run only closed consented experiments with mature follow-up and guarded evaluation

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Closed heading pilot uses stable assignment, visible exposure, authoritative RSVP outcomes, fixed enrollment/follow-up, actual staff exclusion, consent withdrawal and anonymous attrition. Null/future starts fail closed. Evaluation never publishes a variant. Isolated SQL verified role and lifecycle behavior; production activation remains LIVE-2281. New focused regressions failed before implementation; existing probes were preserved. Implementation proof does not assert production activation. Exact unchanged policy consequence probe fails on current main d012ac9d2 because the closed evaluator is absent. Assignment retention is enforced through a service-only bounded 180-day purge with exact counts and visible failure logging; existing cron tests remain byte-identical. pgTAP lifecycle coverage is included for trusted replay; UI mounting and production application remain separate release steps. Daniel item-specifically authorized the prepared three-entry admin-client baseline resolution with his exact reply "apply it" on 2026-11-14. Applied reviewed patch SHA25637ca0024ba4608ae6de9a24622533f54a4f5337dee58795960cd48cf882d915b to current main baseline, preserving newer main entries and excluding retired lib/analytics/audience.ts. No probe, test assertion, threshold or SQL changed by this resolution. Current main now includes a different migration at version46000; migration ordering/readiness must be reconciled before release, and no SQL is applied. Current-main merge verification: 37 focused experiment tests across seven files and both unchanged policy and isolated PostgreSQL SQL integration probes pass. Required check:backlog passes2691 entries/998 agreeing probes; this does not imply migration uniqueness. The separate migration source guard fails because both analytics_experiments and the newly landed hunt_reward_redeem files claim version20270346046000. The normal merge remains blocked from push/release pending Claude version assignment and Daniel item-specific approval for the frozen SQL probe filename reference; no SQL bytes, migration filename or probe assertion has changed. Daniel item-specifically approved the displayed filename-only migration/probe update with his exact reply "yes" on 2026-11-14. Renamed only the unapplied analytics migration46000 to46500 and changed its single probe URL filename; SQL SHA256ebefee10a1e936f2e7516ecd6a70fb1242ce0638bedf517522ecbdfb6cb894bb is unchanged, and the probe differs only at that filename with every assertion preserved. Shared coordination contains the version46500 reservation request; no production SQL application, merge or flag activation is authorized by this path correction. Trusted source registration/staging must be refreshed for this head.
